page.title: Resolution center
page.intro: Track, answer and add evidence to the refund and damage claims you opened from a booking page or that were raised against you. If you can't agree, the claim goes to an administrator.

admin.pageIntro: Review and decide claims the parties could not resolve. Chargebacks are handled by the payment provider.
admin.title: Claims

list.title: My claims
list.emptyHow: Refund and damage claims are opened from the booking's page. Guests can open a claim once the stay has started, up to {days} days after check-out.
list.respondCta: Your reply is needed: respond by {date}. If the deadline passes, the claim goes to an administrator without your reply.
list.awaitingOther: Waiting for the other party to reply by {date}. If they don't, the claim goes to an administrator.

deposit.title: Damage deposit
deposit.none: This booking has no damage deposit.
deposit.expected: Expected deposit: {amount}. It is held on your card as a pre-authorization shortly before check-in.
deposit.note: The deposit is not charged; only a pre-authorization is placed. It is released at the end of the period unless a damage claim is approved. With a split payment the pre-authorization is placed on the organizer’s (booking owner’s) card; participants’ cards are not used.

panel.title: Damage deposit and resolution center
panel.noClaims: No claims have been opened for this booking.

open.infoGuest: If something went wrong with your stay, request a refund. You can open a claim once your stay has started, up to {days} days after check-out. The host is given time to reply; if they don't, the claim goes to an administrator.
open.infoHost: File a claim for damage that occurred during the stay. An approved amount is captured only up to the damage deposit pre-authorization.
open.adminInfo: Admins cannot open claims; review claims from the admin panel.
open.amountHint: Enter the amount in the main currency unit, for example 1250 or 1,250.50.
open.descriptionHint: Describe what happened (10 to 4000 characters). You can add evidence after the claim is opened.
open.created: Your claim for {amount} has been opened.
open.viewCreated: View the claim and add evidence
open.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero, for example 1250 or 1,250.50.
open.descriptionTooShort: The description must be at least {min} characters (leading and trailing spaces don't count).
open.alreadyOpen: You already have an open claim for this booking. Follow that one instead of opening a new claim.

detail.withdrawConfirm: Are you sure you want to withdraw this claim? This cannot be undone.

messages.title: Messages
messages.label: Your message
messages.slaBreach: The response deadline passed; the claim was escalated to an admin.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.privacy: For your privacy, location (GPS), EXIF and all other metadata is removed from uploaded files on the server.
evidence.limits: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF photos (up to {imageMb} MB) or PDF (up to {pdfMb} MB). Up to {maxFiles} files per claim; {used} uploaded so far.
evidence.visibility: Files you upload are visible to the other party and the administrator. Uploaded files can't be removed later.
evidence.tooLarge: The file is {size} MB; files of this type can be at most {max} MB.
evidence.badType: This file type isn't supported. Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF) or a PDF.

decision.title: Decide
decision.amountHint: Must be less than the requested amount ({amount}). Example: 1,250 or 1,250.50
decision.invalidAmount: The partial amount must be greater than zero and less than the requested amount.
decision.pspManaged: Chargebacks are handled by the payment provider and cannot be decided here.
decision.closed: This claim is resolved; no further decision can be made.
decision.explainRefund: Approving a refund claim refunds the guest: from escrow if the funds are still held, otherwise from the host's reserve / balance after release; the platform covers any shortfall.
decision.explainDamage: Approving a damage claim captures at most the damage deposit pre-authorization; any excess is only recorded as "uncollected".

confirm.refund: The guest will be refunded {amount}. It comes from escrow if the money is still held, otherwise from the host's balance.
confirm.damage: Up to {amount} will be collected from the guest on the host's behalf (limited to the damage deposit).
confirm.reject: The claim will be rejected; no one will be paid.
confirm.final: This decision cannot be undone. Your note is shown to both parties.

errors.CLAIM_TOO_EARLY: This type of claim cannot be opened yet (before the stay starts / ends).
errors.CLAIM_WINDOW_CLOSED: The window for opening a claim has closed.
errors.CLAIM_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open claim for this booking.
errors.CLAIM_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE: The amount exceeds the refundable limit (at most {amount}).
errors.CLAIM_BOOKING_NOT_ELIGIBLE: A claim cannot be opened for this booking.
errors.CLAIM_TRANSFERRED_BOOKING: Refund claims cannot be opened for transferred bookings.
errors.CLAIM_REFUND_IN_PROGRESS: This claim's refund was partly issued with a different amount; please review it with support.
errors.CLAIM_SPLIT_CAPACITY: There is no refundable amount left on the split-payment shares.
errors.CLAIM_EVIDENCE_LIMIT: The evidence limit for this claim has been reached.
errors.CLAIM_PSP_MANAGED: This claim is managed by the payment provider.
errors.CLAIM_CLOSED: The claim is closed; no action is possible.
errors.CLAIM_NO_PAYMENT: No captured payment was found for this booking.
errors.CLAIM_REFUND_FAILED: The refund failed; please try again later.
errors.PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: Another payment operation is in progress for this booking; try again shortly.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your email address before doing this.
errors.CLAIM_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE_NOAMOUNT: The amount is above the refundable limit. Try a smaller amount.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This claim could not be found, or you don't have access to it.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the details weren't accepted. Check the fields and try again.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Photos can be at most {imageMb} MB and PDFs at most {pdfMb} MB.
errors.unknown: The action couldn't be completed. Please try again shortly.

host.title: Damage deposit
host.intro: The amount held on the guest's card as a pre-authorization before check-in. If left empty for a room type, the listing-wide amount applies.
host.tooHigh: The amount exceeds the limit (at most {amount}).
host.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
host.invalidAmountFormat: We could not read the amount. Enter an amount greater than zero, for example 1500 or 1,500.50.
host.removeConfirmBody: The {amount} deposit for {scope} will be removed. Future bookings will not hold an amount on the guest's card for damage.
